notes.title: From the Makers of Interceptor: Discover Zombie Ship + Movie Launch
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41179976/b5aba4d6452d9feeab4898436d9496697d5e24c2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey there![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]We’re hard at work on [b]Interceptor[/b], and we truly appreciate your support and interest - thanks for adding us to your wishlist! [/p][p]If you enjoy atmospheric horror games with deep storytelling and intense combat, we’ve got something else you might love: we’re also developing [b]Zombie Ship[/b], a survival horror adventure set aboard a haunted vessel filled with danger and dark secrets.[/p][p][i]Check it out here: [url="http://store.steampowered.com/app/3628400/Zombie_Ship/"]Zombie Ship on Steam[/url] (and wishlist it if that’s your vibe!)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]And here’s some exciting news - next week marks the premiere of the animated [b]Zombie Ship[/b] movie, created in Unreal Engine! If you’re into immersive, story-driven horror experiences, be sure to check it out.[/p][p][i][url="https://youtu.be/-5ZKZZgDoOY"]Watch the movie premiere here[/url] July 1st, 2025, 3:00 PM EST / 9:00 PM CET[/i][/p][p][i][url="https://youtu.be/LGNVo4Kv0sY"]Check out the trailer here[/url][/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks for being part of our community. [/p][p]Your support means the world to us and inspires us to keep creating unforgettable worlds and stories![/p]

notes.title: Interceptor Roadmap - Looking Ahead to 2025/2026
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41179976/09983de8dab18c65c11067bc1cefbb8a2f0bb2fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to share a broad look at the roadmap for [b]Interceptor[/b] - our upcoming single-player action game landing on Steam in 2026. Here’s a glimpse into our vision, what we’re working on, and how you can get involved as we bring this project to life.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What We’re Focusing On[/h2][list][*][p][b]Refining Satisfying Single-Player Action:[/b] Our top priority is delivering intense, rewarding gameplay that feels great every time you play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refining Dynamic, Intuitive Combat:[/b] We’re focused on making combat easy to learn, but with plenty of depth and excitement for those who want to master it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clean, Accessible Interface:[/b] Interceptor is designed to be approachable for everyone, while still offering plenty of fun and challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Meaningful Progression:[/b] We want every stage to feel significant, with clear rewards and a real sense of accomplishment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Constant Balancing and Playtesting:[/b] We’re regularly testing and tweaking the game to make sure it’s as fun and polished as possible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting an Even More Immersive Story:[/b] We’re dedicated to deepening the narrative - making it more engaging and ensuring it feels like an integral part of a vast, cohesive world that draws you in and keeps you hooked.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2][p]We’re building Interceptor with you in mind! Follow our Steam page, drop your comments, ask questions, and share your ideas. Your feedback helps shape the game and makes it better for everyone.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][p]In the coming months, you can look forward to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Devlogs[/b] with gameplay snippets and behind-the-scenes insights,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Community polls[/b] on important features,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regular progress updates[/b] right here on Steam.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Wishlist Interceptor on Steam - every wishlist gives us a real boost and helps the project soar higher. Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: Interceptor – Development Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41179976/532922b3a0d7ee0c9641f0a24c49d652be5c45a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We truly appreciate your interest and all the wishlists - it's a real boost for our team. We're moving development forward, adopting new technologies, and growing our studio to make [i]Interceptor[/i] the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p]In a few days, we'll be sharing our [b]roadmap[/b] with more details about what's ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for following our journey![/p]
